No. The only items in your saved profile are personal reminders (“UNVERIFIED PERSONAL REMINDER: historic 8,400 INR fee; this is not current official evidence”). The system marks these as **taskEvidence: “Personal saved reminders, not current official rule evidence.”** Therefore they cannot prove the current German visa fee or the required blocked‑account (Sperrkonto) amount.

Because there is no verified rule or up‑to‑date source in the retrieved data, I cannot state a fee or amount. To obtain the correct, official figures you must consult the official sources yourself:

* Federal Foreign Office financing page (visa‑related fees): <https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/sperrkonto-388600>  
* uni‑assist handling‑fees page (application/processing fees): <https://www.uni-assist.de/en/how-to-apply/pay-all-fees/handling-fees/>

Those pages contain the current, authoritative amounts. If you need a rule‑level verification of a specific fee, a fresh `search_rules` query would be required, but the present profile does not supply that evidence.
